principles: Direct optional branches of native districts; existing story paths, abilities and purchases remain intact.
Original geometry and distinct identities; borrow only already-seen materials and use far outdoor backdrops.
Existing jump, swing, wall movement and suit abilities suffice. Paid TASM moves provide advantages, never mandatory access.
Strong bounded crews, readable routes and fast combat. No further skills or time-slowing effects.
Every branch has a return route and nearby native checkpoint; native door walks, save/reload and map behavior must be qualified.
Campaign room and flag allocation must share one ledger with Midnight; provisional IDs are not an implemented contract.
qualification_limits: Agent-tested; player fun and frame-rate unmeasured. Native rigs/AI retained. Natural-HP mixed fight uses an explicitly healed60-unit player; crew callback controls cap foes1HP. Reward controls use idle1HP foes with no healing; zero-set is paired. No actor placements in those fights. Separate hoist wins use no refills and copied purchased abilities. UI/art poses suppress births and use labelled held positions; they do not prove traversal.
